product_overview: CuraBook is a digital healthcare platform for patients, doctors, and hospitals in the Egyptian and Arab markets. It enables account access, appointment booking workflows, doctor scheduling, and role-based dashboards for managing care operations.
core_goals: Allow users to create accounts and sign in to access their role-specific experience
Enable patients, doctors, and hospital admins to view their dedicated dashboards after authentication
Allow doctors to manage their booking schedule and available time slots
Provide a patient-facing dashboard for viewing appointments and health-related records
Provide a doctor-facing dashboard for managing appointments and patient records
Provide a hospital admin dashboard for managing hospital operations and summaries

features.name: User Login
features.description: Lets returning users sign in with their account credentials to access protected areas of the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email address -> Enter password -> Submit the login form -> See the authenticated destination page
Navigate to /login -> Enter an invalid email or password combination -> Submit the login form -> See a login error message

features.name: Patient Registration
features.description: Allows a new patient to create an account for accessing patient services.
user_flows: Navigate to /signup -> Enter registration details -> Submit the signup form -> See confirmation of account creation or next-step access to sign in

features.name: Doctor Registration
features.description: Allows a new doctor to create an account for accessing doctor services and dashboards.
user_flows: Navigate to /doctor-signup -> Enter registration details -> Submit the signup form -> See confirmation of account creation or next-step access to sign in

features.name: Patient Dashboard
features.description: Provides authenticated patients with a central place to review their appointments and health records.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Sign in with patient credentials -> See the patient dashboard with appointments and records summaries

features.name: Doctor Dashboard
features.description: Provides authenticated doctors with a central workspace for reviewing appointments and patient records.
user_flows: Navigate to /doctor-dashboard -> Sign in with doctor credentials -> See the doctor dashboard with appointments and patient record summaries

features.name: Hospital Dashboard
features.description: Provides authenticated hospital administrators with a dashboard for managing hospital-level information.
user_flows: Navigate to /hospital-dashboard -> Sign in with hospital admin credentials -> See the hospital dashboard with administrative summaries

features.name: Doctor Schedule Management
features.description: Allows doctors to review and maintain their weekly availability and booking slots.
user_flows: Navigate to the doctor schedule page -> View the schedule calendar -> Create a new slot or modify an existing slot -> See the updated schedule reflected in the calendar
Navigate to the doctor schedule page -> View the schedule calendar -> Attempt to create an overlapping slot -> See validation prevent the conflicting slot from being saved
